title: Odd-power rows of the binary Vandermonde matrix
statement: Let $k,n$ be nonnegative integers, let $\ell$ be positive, and let $\alpha$ assign a point of the degree-$\ell$ extension field of $\mathbb{F}_2$ to each of $n$ columns. For every row indexed by $q<k/2$ and a basis coordinate $i<\ell$, the entry in column $j$ is the $i$th coordinate, in the chosen basis, of $\alpha_j^{2q+1}$.
hypotheses_covered: $\alpha$ assigns a degree-$\ell$ binary extension-field point to each column
